tasks.title: Product Vision, Principles & 8-Domain Capability Mapping
tasks.description: Create PRODUCT.md, PRODUCT_CAPABILITIES.md, PRODUCT_PRINCIPLES.md, and ROADMAP.md establishing the Places, People, Experiences loop and 8 capability domains.
acceptanceCriteria: Product vision and 6 core product principles documented.
Full 8-domain capability map established across Capability Complete, Product Integrated, and Platform Ready tiers.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Foundational specification artifact; prevents disposable MVP-only architectural shortcuts.

tasks.title: Frontend Architecture Evaluation & ADR 003 Ratification
tasks.description: Evaluate Flutter + Riverpod vs. React + mobile wrapper across 11 technical dimensions and record the decision in docs/adr/003-frontend-stack-decision.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Both candidates evaluated against native experience, maps, camera, navigation, state management, testing, and maintenance.
Flutter (lib/) ratified as the sole canonical mobile application.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Eliminates parallel frontend divergence while preserving src/ strictly as a read-only visual reference.

tasks.title: 8-Domain Entity-Relationship & Data Contract Architecture
tasks.description: Define relationships across Users, Profiles, Friendships, Places, Drops, Media, Collections, Plans, Stories, Notifications, Reports, and Blocks in ARCHITECTURE.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Mermaid ER diagram and 8-domain module boundaries documented in ARCHITECTURE.md.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Establishes single source of truth for domain contracts.

tasks.title: Repository Consolidation & Build Artifact Purge
tasks.description: Remove committed node_modules/ (3,077 files, ~97 MB), align README/ADRs/CI, and standardize source organization.
acceptanceCriteria: No committed node_modules or build output in repository archive.
README, ADRs, and CI accurately reflect the canonical architecture.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Reduces repository archive size by >90% and prevents platform-locked binary failures.

tasks.title: Critical Database Security Remediation (SEC-01 & SEC-02)
tasks.description: Remediate get_friends_feed spoofing (SEC-01) and friendship self-acceptance (SEC-02) in baseline and corrective migrations, and add SQL authorization tests.
acceptanceCriteria: get_friends_feed is SECURITY INVOKER and derives caller strictly from auth.uid().
friendships_update_recipient_only policy and enforce_friendship_transition trigger prevent self-acceptance.
Negative authorization tests in rls_authorization_test.sql verify all 8 invariants.
tasks.riskAssessment: Critical blocker resolved: Prevents unauthorized access to friends-only content.

tasks.title: Application Stabilization & Canonical Tashkent Seed Alignment
tasks.description: Unify all venue and profile IDs on Tashkent, repair Story Rail and Friends Feed seeds, fix .whereType<PlaceModel>(), and remove deprecated_member_use suppression.
acceptanceCriteria: Friends Feed renders valid Tashkent drops on launch.
Every Story Rail item resolves to a valid Tashkent venue.
Saved screen uses .whereType<PlaceModel>() and functional status filters.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: All legacy aliases map cleanly via resolveCanonicalId.

tasks.title: Native Mobile Foundation & Toolchain Constraints
tasks.description: Configure iOS Info.plist & PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, Android camera/location/internet permissions, and fix pubspec.yaml SDK constraint to ^3.5.0.
acceptanceCriteria: iOS and Android permission declarations and privacy manifests are complete.
Dart SDK constraint ^3.5.0 resolves cleanly.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Prevents runtime permission crashes on iOS 17+ and Android 13/14.

tasks.title: Backend Infrastructure, Environment Config & Observability
tasks.description: Configure supabase/config.toml, .env.example, compile-time --dart-define initialization with service_role guard, and structured AppLogger telemetry.
acceptanceCriteria: Credentials injected via build-time --dart-define variables.
service_role keys are rejected if accidentally passed.
All repository errors are logged through AppLogger.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Graceful local fallback preserved when running offline tests.

tasks.title: Identity Lifecycle, Authentication & Profile Triggers
tasks.description: Implement /auth Sign Up & Sign In screen, session persistence, sign-out, automatic on_auth_user_created profile creation trigger, and profile editing.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can register, sign in, edit their profile, and sign out.
handle_new_user() trigger provisions public.profiles automatically.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Username format and uniqueness constraints enforced in SQL and Dart.

tasks.title: Media Storage Infrastructure & Upload Lifecycle
tasks.description: Provision post-media Storage bucket with 5MB & MIME RLS policies, client validation, persistent base64/Storage upload, and orphan media cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: Only JPEG, PNG, and WebP images <= 5 MB are accepted.
Picked photos survive OS temp cache purges and clean up orphans on DB error.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Dual-layer Storage RLS prevents unauthorized media reads.

tasks.title: Places Domain: Geospatial Discovery, Search & Tashkent Map
tasks.description: Implement PostGIS get_nearby_places with search_query and category filters, FlutterMap rendering, Haversine distances, custom venue creation, and external directions.
acceptanceCriteria: Search and category chips filter Tashkent venues across Map and List modes.
Haversine distance calculation and denied-permission fallback work cleanly.
tasks.riskAssessment: Medium: Production deployment should inject a commercial MAP_TILE_URL key via --dart-define.

tasks.title: Social Graph Domain: Mutual Friendship State Machine & User Profiles
tasks.description: Implement FriendshipStatusesNotifier (none, pendingOutgoing, pendingIncoming, accepted), incoming request accept/decline UI, and /users/:id profile navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: System distinguishes pendingOutgoing, pendingIncoming, and accepted friendships.
Tapping any user avatar navigates to /users/:id.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Backed by recipient-only RLS policy in 00002/00005.

tasks.title: Experiences Domain: Drop Creation, Editing, Deletion & Rating Sync
tasks.description: Implement 4-step Drop creation, publishDrop, editDrop, deleteDrop, and automatic venue rating recalculation trigger (recalculate_place_rating).
acceptanceCriteria: Users can publish, edit, and delete their own Drops.
Publishing or deleting a rated public Drop recalculates places.avg_rating.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Ownership verified via author_id = auth.uid().

tasks.title: Discovery Domain: Dual-Layer Feeds & Place Detail Partitioning
tasks.description: Implement finite Friends Feed (syncRemoteFeed -> get_friends_feed), Public Discovery, and partitioned Friends vs. Public tabs on Place Detail screens.
acceptanceCriteria: Friends Feed only displays drops from accepted friends and self.
Place Detail tabs strictly separate Friends Drops from Public Reviews.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Verified by unit and SQL authorization tests.

tasks.title: Collections Domain: Saved Places (Want to go / Been) & Custom Lists
tasks.description: Implement SavedPlaceStatusesNotifier (want_to_go, been), segmented filtering on SavedScreen, and public.collections + collection_items schema.
acceptanceCriteria: Want to go and Been filters work and persist across sessions.
Custom and collaborative collections schema and RLS policies active in 00006.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Synced with public.saved_places and trg_saved_places_count.

tasks.title: Social Ecosystem: Friend Plans, 24h Stories, Reactions, Comments & Notifications
tasks.description: Implement FriendPlansNotifier, NotificationsScreen, and database schemas/RLS for friend_plan_participants (RSVP), place_stories (24h expiration), post_reactions, and post_comments.
acceptanceCriteria: Friend plans, notifications, stories, reactions, and comments persist in PostgreSQL and honor dual-layer RLS and blocking.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: All engagement tables enforce NOT is_blocked() and audience visibility.

tasks.title: Trust & Safety Operations: Blocking, 3-Report Quarantine, Audit Logs & GDPR Lifecycle
tasks.description: Implement user blocking, content reporting, 3-report auto-quarantine trigger, moderation_audit_logs table, GDPR JSON export, and server-side delete_own_account() RPC.
acceptanceCriteria: 3 reports automatically quarantine a Drop and record an entry in moderation_audit_logs.
GDPR export and delete_own_account() RPC work without a client service_role key.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Full audit trail maintained in public.moderation_audit_logs.

tasks.title: Intelligent Discovery: Explainable Privacy-Preserving Recommendations
tasks.description: Implement get_recommended_places() PostGIS/SQL RPC and PlacesRepository.getRecommendedPlaces scoring venues by accepted friends' drops, saved category affinity, and rating.
acceptanceCriteria: Every recommendation includes a human-readable explanation and numeric relevanceScore.
Private visits from non-friends are never used as global ranking signals.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Explainable deterministic scoring avoids opaque ML cold-start issues.

tasks.title: Platform Maturity, Automated Regression Suites & CI/CD Release Gates
tasks.description: Maintain unit, widget, and SQL RLS regression tests, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, rate-limiting triggers, and RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md / SECURITY_CHECKLIST.md.
acceptanceCriteria: All 8 domains verified at Product Integrated / Platform Ready maturity.
CI/CD and SQL security test suites pass with zero open Critical/High issues.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Continuous regression gates active on every pull request.
